blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sibol opens its gold medal quest for the Philippines in the Naraka: Bladepoint and Puyo Puyo Champions in the Asian Games 2026 esports competitions starting on Wednesday at Aichi Sky Expo. Richard Espejo, Von Teñoso, Kenneth Perez, and Joaquin Paclibar will lead the Philippines’ Naraka: Bladepoint team, with Paclibar also competing in the solo category Naraka: Bladepoint is a melee-focused action game featuring swordplay, ranged weapons, character abilities, and grappling-hook movement.
